# Pipedrive Connector for Muse

💳 Paid plan required: Pipedrive has no permanent free tier (14-day trial only) — the listing is free, but a paid Pipedrive subscription is required. See Prerequisites for details.

A Muse agent skill that manages your Pipedrive CRM: list your deals with all filters, list contacts, and create a new deal. Honest note: Pipedrive has no free tier for its product — only a 14-day free trial, so this connector is effectively gated behind a paid Pipedrive subscription. Deal creation is confirmation-gated, and the CLI's default deal ordering is opaque — the skill asks rather than guessing, and prefers the exact `deals` (not `deal`) command. Draft: written from Pipedrive's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
